Version 1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated SKILL.md to a more concise, structured, and user-focused format with clear overview tables, workflows, and constraints.
- User identity (open-id) handling fully automated and internalized—users are no longer prompted for or required to input any identifier.
- All history/report queries now strictly enforced to use cloud API calls; reading from local memory or aggregation is forbidden.
- Obsolete/duplicate files (scripts/api_service.py, skill-card.md) removed.
- Other updates for clarity and accuracy in documentation and code references.
- Compatibility and requirements unchanged; core workflow and capability remain consistent.

Initial release of abnormal fish swimming posture detection and analysis skill.

- Analyzes aquarium camera video to detect abnormal fish swimming by measuring body axis angle and rotations.
- Flags and quantifies behaviors such as side-swimming, upside-down, floating/sinking, and rapid rotations for early health issue detection (e.g., swim bladder disorder, poisoning).
- Provides continuous monitoring with daily health posture reports and multi-level alerting, from mild reminders to urgent interventions.
- Features fish species-adaptive baselines, structured report outputs, and integration options for smart aquariums.
- Strong access and data integrity controls, mandating valid open-id for all report queries and analysis actions.
